- Provide feedback on market trends and competitor activities.

initiatives.
- Collaborate with marketing, product, and customer support teams for a unified approach to
customer satisfaction.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of leads, opportunities, and customer interactions.
- Prepare regular reports on sales and business development activities.
